definitionZh: *slotted() CSS 伪元素代表了HTML模板中放置到槽中的任何元素(更多信息请参见使用模板和槽).
sourceDefinition: The ::slotted() CSS pseudo-element represents any element that has been placed into a slot inside an HTML template (see Using templates and slots for more information).
